unmappedReports: Cyrix-i 400A only: the datasheet lists "Micro switch for remote monitoring — Yes". That is a dry contact reflecting whether the combiner is engaged, and a gateway GPIO input could read it. It maps cleanly to `switch-state`, which makes the Cyrix-i 400A the one member of this group with a route into the contract — via cabin-gpio, not via anything Victron. The Cyrix-ct datasheets do not list this feature; do not assume it., Cyrix status is otherwise indicated by a bicolour LED only. "Start Assist" (Cyrix remains engaged for 30 seconds, on the ct; "Emergency start, Yes, 30 s" on the i-400A) has no metric and no command.
